subject: Model mix & pricing follow-up - token volumes & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Model mix & pricing follow-up - token volumes & next steps

Hi Sam / Aisha -

Thanks again for the call earlier - great context on the search+recommendation pilot and the longer-term personalization roadmap. Per our discussion, I wanted to capture the model mix and a preliminary cost/volume view so we can align on targets and next steps.

Recap of what I heard from your team:
- Pilot (Q3): 20M tokens/month (ingest + interactive search).
- Target production (Q4-Q1): scale to 200M tokens/month across use cases.
- Model mix estimate: chat/generation for UI assistants + session context, embeddings for semantic search & similarity, and a small rerank step for top-k ordering.
- Target commercial objective: unit economics at or below the $1.5k-$1.9k per 1M tokens range (company target $/1M tokens).

Preliminary model-mix pricing (per 1M tokens, internal list prices used for illustration):
- Chat (assistant/generation): 70% of token volume - internal list: $1,200 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings (semantic search/indexing): 25% of token volume - internal list: $3,000 / 1M tokens
- Rerank (top-k reordering): 5% of token volume - internal list: $600 / 1M tokens

Weighted blended cost for the mix above = (0.70 * $1,200) + (0.25 * $3,000) + (0.05 * $600) = $1,620 per 1M tokens.

Notes / assumptions:
- This is a host/served-price illustrative blend (we'll nail exact lists once you confirm preferred model variants and whether you want Dedicated or Hosted).
- Embedding unit cost is higher per 1M tokens (smaller dense vectors, more compute per request) so the fraction of embeddings has large impact on blended $/1M.
- Volume tiers / committed capacity (Dedicated) can materially improve the blended rate - we can model tiered discounts if you can share 6-12 month cadence.

Ask / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the expected monthly token ramp (pilot -> month-1 production -> steady-state)? e.g., Pilot 20M, month1 50M, steady 200M.
2) Confirm the model mix if you want to use the percentages above or the adjusted split Sam suggested on the call (we can re-run the blended math).
3) I attached a preliminary pricing estimate and a draft mutual action plan (MAP). Can you review and flag any procurement/blockers?
4) Logan / Dev - can you prepare a short note on expected p95 latency and throughput characteristics for the chat and embedding flows at 200M tokens/month (QPS assumptions) so we can include SLOs in the MAP?

Planned follow-up: I'll send a formal estimate and MAP by EOD Friday and propose a 30-min alignment call next week to lock volumes and PM/procurement timeline.

Thanks -
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: ACME_Redwood_pricing_estimate_Q3.xlsx; Mutual_Action_Plan_Acme_Redwood.docx; SOC2_Type2_Summary.pdf

From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up - token volumes & next steps

Thanks Marissa - this is super helpful. A few quick clarifications from our side after syncing with the engineering team: 
- Ramp profile we expect: pilot (Q3) ~20M tokens/month, month-1 post-pilot ~60M, steady-state goal 180-220M/month by end of Q4.
- Preferred model split (initial production): Chat/generation 65%, Embeddings 30%, Rerank 5%. We may skew embeddings higher for certain search-heavy endpoints, but use 65/30/5 as baseline.
- Budget target: our procurement sponsor is aiming for ~ $1,800 / 1M tokens blended (flexible +/- 10% if there are clear SLA/latency benefits).

Two asks before we lock in next steps: 
1) Can you provide a 12-month committed pricing option (savings tiers) and a short note on the expected latency p95 for the chat flow and embedding lookup at 2-3k QPS?
2) We need SOC2 evidence (thanks for the PDF) and a short compliance summary for our InfoSec team (data residency / retention and KMS integration details).

If you can get the MAP + pricing by Friday as you mentioned, we'll route to procurement on Monday and aim to have a decision within 2-3 weeks.

Appreciate it - Sam
Senior PM, Personalization | Acme Retail

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up - token volumes & next steps

Great - thanks for confirming the ramp and target blended budget. I've attached the draft pricing estimate (includes a committed-tier option and a Hosted vs Dedicated comparison) and the MAP. High level notes: 
- Baseline blended estimate using your 65/30/5 split = $1,620 / 1M tokens (example using our public-hosted list). With a 12-month commit and a 200M+/month tier, we can get to roughly $1,250-1,400 blended depending on model variants and whether you opt for Dedicated capacity.
- Latency SLOs and throughput notes: Logan/Dev (cc'd) - please see the quick bullets we need to include in the MAP for procurement (p95 targets and expected instances at 200M/mo).

Proposed next steps:
- Monday: I'll share an updated estimate reflecting the 65/30/5 mix and the tiered committed discount scenario + a DocuSign-ready contract stub.
- Tues: 30-min joint call with procurement + engineering to run the MAP and SLAs. Can we do Tuesday 10am PT?

Sam - can you confirm Tuesday 10am PT works and who from procurement will join (name + email)? If procurement wants a 1-page procurement checklist, I can include that in the DocuSign package.

Thanks -
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: prep notes for Acme sync (latency & capacity)

Quick internal note - looped you in above for visibility. Logan / Dev: please prepare a 1-page tech note that includes:
- Expected p95 latency (ms) for chat path at 2-3k QPS with 2-4k token average context sizes.
- Expected p95 latency for embedding lookups at the target QPS (include vector size assumptions).
- Capacity/instance estimates for Dedicated at 200M tokens/month and cost delta vs Hosted.
- Any constraints around cold-starts, KV cache priming and recommended batching windows (for procurement to understand ops lift).

If you can drop the note into the shared Drive link by EOD Monday, I'll bundle into the MAP and pricing packet.

- Marissa
